name: Gulhadar III
description: Gulhadar III, also known simply as Gulhadar, was a prison planet in the Gulhadar system of the Inner Rim Territories that was under the control of the Benelex Marshal Service. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the Wookiee Chewbacca was imprisoned on Gulhadar alongside the pirate Maz Kanata, Doctor Cornelius Evazan, and Ponda Baba.
